summary: Multi-mode OSINT backend+frontend tested. Backend 13/13 pytest cases passed including: health, settings (shodan_key field + mask), mode validation (ip/domain/website/dork incl. IP regex rejects '8.8.8' and 'example.com'), /api/scans list+get include `mode` field, E2E IP scan 8.8.8.8 (Shodan found=true, org='Google LLC', ports include 443, passive_dns>0, services>0, ip_whois populated), E2E website scan for example.com (live_hosts, tls_certs, tech_fingerprints, dns_records, ips, ip_whois populated; NO subdomains in website mode), E2E full domain scan with skip_ss+skip_dork (domain, dns_records, subdomains, per-IP shodan, ip_whois all populated). Frontend verified via Playwright: 4 mode tabs (tab-domain/website/ip/dork) clickable with cyan selected-border, IP mode swaps placeholder to 8.8.8.8 and hides Skip Dirs/Dork/SS toggles, invalid IP '8.8.8' and domain 'example.com' in IP mode show toast 'Enter a valid IPv4', valid 8.8.8.8 submits & navigates to detail, IP detail renders sec-shodan section, History page at /scans shows MODE column with per-row badges (IP, DOMAIN), Settings page exposes data-testid=input-shodan_key, save flow shows 'API keys saved' toast and persists key. Real shodan key restored after PUT test.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager (carried over from iter_1).
asyncio.create_task(_run_scan) return value is not tracked — in-flight scans silently lost on worker restart. Acceptable for MVP but document it.
Navbar links labelled 'HISTORY' route to /scans (not /history) — consistent once you know it, but a /history alias would be friendlier. Not a bug.

IP-mode IP INTELLIGENCE panel renders '—' for CC/ORG/REP/FLAG even though Shodan has org='Google LLC' — the sec-shodan panel separately shows correct data, but the shared IpIntel component could enrich from shodan.org when ipinfo is missing.
test_credentials: No auth required. Shodan key in /app/backend/.env is live and valid for 8.8.8.8.
seed_data_creation: Tests create & delete their own scans (example.com + 8.8.8.8); dummy shodan_key value PUT then real env key restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 modes (domain/website/ip/dork) functional end-to-end. Use skip_screenshots+skip_dorking for domain-mode tests to stay <90s. IP scans for 8.8.8.8 complete in ~15s. History lives at /scans and shows MODE column. sec-shodan / sec-pdns / sec-ip-whois data-testids present on IP-mode detail pages. Shodan key in .env (0BXChZZudHwhQPdDGSNRYZJyOUdLP4m6) is real; tests temporarily overwrite and restore it.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
